prompts.label: 1｜マットブラック
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. EDIT Image 1, a polished Japanese iPhone lofi app screenshot. Image 1 is the edit target and mandatory layout reference; Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the tiny ruler TICK MARKS beside its fader tracks. Preserve the HORIZONTAL INLINE LIST layout from Image 1, NOT the vertical columns from Image 2. Keep the upper screen's underlined Japanese rooftop title, small settings icon, left numbered circles and blue neon pixel-art rooftop in the same positions, dimmed naturally behind the sheet. One single full portrait iPhone screenshot, same aspect ratio as Image 1. No physical device frame, no collage, no extra presentation labels.
Primary request: refine the AUDIO SHEET'S MATERIAL AND TYPOGRAPHIC DETAILS and add subtle ruler graduations to all five horizontal volume controls. Maintain the header "この場所の音", drag handle, small close button; BGM with "Night Signal", small outlined pause button and full-width horizontal volume rail; below, FOUR COMPACT SINGLE-LINE rows for "作業音", "葉擦れ", "雨", "暖炉". Each row contains a thin-line icon, label, horizontal slider, right aligned percentage. ALL FIVE sound channels visible without scrolling. Exact BGM 64%, 作業音 0%, 葉擦れ 46%, 雨 72%, 暖炉 0%. Music/leaves/rain active, keyboard/fire inactive. No iOS toggle switches, no cards, no vertical faders, no new features. Thin rails, tiny rounded slider thumbs, precise 44pt interaction spacing, beautiful understated off-white Japanese typography, warm champagne active slider strokes and icons, gray inactive controls.
Crucial new detail: Each HORIZONTAL slider must include an understated instrument-scale ruler: eleven evenly spaced very fine SHORT VERTICAL tick strokes immediately BELOW the horizontal rail, with the first/middle/last ticks a little longer, like Image 2 rotated to horizontal. These are visible designed graduations, not text, not a waveform, not a row of dots, not a striped slider. Each tick about 3–5px long on the mockup. No numbers on ticks. Keep space around these delicate scales so the sheet feels calm and refined.
Only vary the modal background/material according to the following direction. The point is to compare MATERIALS with the same UI layout. No bright colored UI outlines, no neon glow on controls, no shiny 3D, no trendy blobs. Premium restrained iOS app aesthetic. Keep all type highly legible and avoid overlap or clipped controls. DIRECTION 1, OPAQUE MATTE BLACK: The sheet surface is truly opaque, almost pure ink-black #070709. No transparency, no city visible through the sheet, no blur, no colored light leaks. Distinguish it subtly from the underlying near-black app with a hairline graphite top edge and softly rounded top corners. Fine warm ivory typography and warmer champagne ruler controls provide contrast; inactive channels remain clear charcoal-gray. Make this a deliberately beautiful minimal matte instrument panel rather than a generic settings form. Quiet measured whitespace, slightly smaller elegant header, almost invisible dividers. Render the material difference unmistakably: solid black sheet.
